content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Tirupati Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Tirupati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Tirupati Non-Teaching Posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Tirupati Non-Teaching Posts is 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for IIT Tirupati Non-Teaching Posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies available for various Non-Teaching Posts at the Indian Institute of Technology Tirupati.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification varies by post, but generally includes a Bachelor's/Master's/Ph.D degree in relevant fields with a minimum of 55% marks. Specific experience is also required for most positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the IIT Tirupati Non-Teaching Recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the Non-Teaching Posts is 50 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: For General/OBC category candidates, the application fee varies by group: Group A is Rs.500 (application) + Rs.200 (processing), Group B is Rs.300 + Rs.200, and Group C is Rs.200 + Rs.200.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any application fee exemptions?
faq.answer: Yes, SC/ST and Women candidates are exempt from the application fee but are required to pay the processing fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process may include a Screening Test/Interview or both for Group A posts, and an Objective-Based Test, Written Test, and Skill/Trade Test for Group B & C posts.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for IIT Tirupati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary range for the Non-Teaching Posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 25,500 to Rs. 2,15,900 per month, depending on the post and its corresponding pay level.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Andhra Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment is open to eligible candidates across India. The institute is located in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, but the application process is online.
